title: iHeartPodcasts and Global Gaming League Launch “Get Familiar With Clinton Sparks”
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
**WHAT:** iHeartPodcasts and Global Gaming League today debut a new podcast, "[Get Familiar with Clinton Sparks](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-get-familiar-with-clinton-347193727) ," hosted by Grammy-nominated, multi-platinum producer, entrepreneur and Global Gaming League CEO Clinton Sparks. From business advice and life lessons to outrageous detours, every episode will feel like hanging out with friends who have lots to say and absolutely no filter.


In Season one of “Get Familiar with Clinton Sparks,” Sparks will bring his unfiltered perspective and unpredictable interview style to conversations with celebrities, business leaders and fascinating personalities. With candid discussions, unexpected stories, hard-earned wisdom and plenty of humor – no topic will be off limits.


**WHO:** Clinton Sparks is the CEO of Global Gaming League and a Grammy-nominated, multi-platinum producer, songwriter, DJ, entrepreneur, and speaker. Throughout his career, he has built and launched successful brands and products while helping shape culture through music, entertainment, and innovation.


In the first episode, Sparks will sit down with Shaq to talk life after sports, his accidental rap career, Biggie and more. The series will also feature conversations with Fat Joe, Daymond John, Akon, T.I., Bozoma Saint John, Brian Austin Green, Swae Lee, Ray-J, Lil Yachty, Jermaine Dupri, JaRule and more.


**WHEN:** First episode available today, Thursday, October 15, 2026.


**WHERE:** Listen to “[Get Familiar with Clinton Sparks](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-get-familiar-with-clinton-347193727) ” on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard.


**About Global Gaming League:**


The Global Gaming League (GGL) is a new kind of video game entertainment league—where gaming, culture, music, sports, fashion, and reality TV collide. With celebrity-led teams, live competitions, a platform for global fan participation, and next-gen media experiences, GGL is building the first entertainment system for the world’s largest and most engaged audience.
